utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’m happy to help with the repair drive—what do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Mara — I’m a little late to this, but could you help sort donated tools and maybe keep an eye on the sign-in table?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely — I can sort the donated tools and cover the sign-in table for a while.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good — what time should I bring the tools?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Could you bring them by 3 PM? If that’s tricky, let me know and we can adjust.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: 3 PM works for me — I’ll bring the tools then.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can check what supplies we already have and what we still need for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, thanks — I probably missed what changed. Let me know what we still need and I’ll help if I can.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ll take inventory and make a quick list of what’s missing, then I’ll bring it over so we can split it up.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’m happy to help with the repair drive. What still needs doing?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Rey — I’m mostly worried about the pickup schedule and making sure we have enough boxes and tape. If you can help check what’s still missing, that would be a huge relief.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can check what’s missing and help sort the pickup schedule. I’ll ask around and report back with what we still need.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: How’s the repair drive going, Nell? Do you need any help sorting donations or making calls?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: I can help sort donations or make calls—what do you need most right now?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, the repair drive? I heard they’re still collecting tools and supplies, and folks are hoping to get a good turnout this weekend.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yeah, I can lend a few tools and maybe swing by to help out this weekend.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: That’d be wonderful, Gus — I’m sure they’d really appreciate it. I’ll spread the word that you’re pitching in.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, I’m telling everyone about the repair drive—Opal, you should come by and bring anyone else who wants to help!

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’ll come by and bring a few neighbors who can help.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: That’s wonderful, thank you! The more hands we have, the faster we can get everything fixed.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing — I can help out with the repair drive. What do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, you’re still available to help with the repair drive, right?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Yes, I’m still available to help with the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely — I’ll help keep the repair drive organized and moving. What do you want to tackle first?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Let’s start with the most urgent repairs and make a quick list. I’ll skim it and help where I can.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good — I’ll spread the word about the repair drive and keep everyone posted.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Vik. I’ll be there at the usual time and bring the sign-up sheet.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Perfect, I’ll make sure folks hear about it and know the usual time.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right—the repair drive. I can help out, I just need a quick reminder of what’s needed.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Oren. We need tools, a bit of lumber, and anyone who can lend a hand for a few hours.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sure thing — I can bring a couple tools and stay for a few hours. Just tell me where and when to show up.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m glad to help bridge folks together for the repair drive — want me to spread the word or coordinate with anyone?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Yeah, could you spread the word? I’ll swing by and help where I can after I finish my errands.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I’ll let folks know you’re coming by after your errands, and I’ll point them your way for whatever needs doing.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I’m spreading the word about the repair drive now—want me to put your name down and bring you a flyer?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Yeah, put me down—I'll probably swing by late, but a flyer would help. Thanks, Quinn.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll add you and drop off a flyer. See you there, even if it’s late!

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sure thing — I’d like to know the plan and what time you’re thinking for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’m thinking we keep it simple—start around 10 on Saturday and see what needs doing first. I can bring a few tools, if that helps.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help coordinate around pickup and school drop-off times for the repair drive. What schedule works best for you?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That would be really helpful—mornings after school drop-off work best for me. I can also help with pickup coordination on Thursday if needed.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Morning after drop-off works for me too, and thanks for offering Thursday pickup help. I’ll line up the repair drive around that schedule.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m happy to help with the repair drive—want me to check who still needs a hand?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yes, please—could you check who still needs a hand and let me know?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I’ll check and get back to you with who still needs a hand.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure, I can lend a hand with that—what tools do you need for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I can bring a drill, hammer, and a few screwdrivers if that helps.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I don’t have any location details yet for the repair drive, Rosa. If you want, I can help keep track as soon as we know where it’s happening.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Opal — that’d be a big help. Let’s keep an eye out for the location, and I’ll share it with the block once we have it.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Absolutely — I’ll keep watch for the location and pass it along once it’s confirmed.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Did the repair drive get a confirmed date yet?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Not yet — I want to double-check the details before I say for sure.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I’m happy to help with the repair drive. What do you need me to do?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Sam — could you help keep track of the donated supplies as they come in?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I’ve only heard bits and pieces about the repair drive—what’s the latest?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, uh, I think they’re still collecting stuff for it? I might’ve missed the latest update, but I can check around.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, I’d appreciate that — I’ve only been catching little updates here and there.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Repair drive, right? Just want to make sure I’ve got that straight.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yep, the repair drive — folks are gathering donations and fixes for the neighborhood stuff.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Got it — so it’s donations and repairs for the neighborhood stuff, right?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, I heard the repair drive’s getting pretty busy—what do you still need help with?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Mostly just a hand with the porch step and maybe the front gate. I’d really appreciate it.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I can help with that—I'll swing by after my errands and take a look at the porch step and gate.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right—the repair drive. I’d be glad to help out; just remind me what needs doing again.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: We need donations sorted, the tools listed, and a few volunteers for pickup and drop-off.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Got it—I'll sort the donations, make a tools list, and see who can help with pickup and drop-off.
